featured_reviews.name: Hemant Bhoyar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a client with Fintoo for about 1.5 years, and overall, my experience has been very positive.

The primary strength of Fintoo is the comprehensive service and the quality of their advice. They cover the full spectrum—from detailed tax planning and comprehensive financial goal setting, all the way through to direct stock insights and recommendations. I especially appreciate that the wealth managers (I've worked with a few, and the transitions have been smooth) always take the time to explain the rationale behind their stock and fund selections. This transparency is crucial. A special mention goes to Ashish, whose deep understanding of the stock market and quick response time on queries have been exceptional. Furthermore, Akshay's expertise in tax planning has been invaluable.

However, the reason I am giving 4 stars instead of 5 relates to product pushiness. There have been several occasions where I felt some pushiness to allocate funds toward specific, higher-commission products. These often appeared to be dodgy investment options with aggregated returns that I projected would be less than 5% overall across a two-year holding period, significantly underperforming benchmark alternatives.

While I am fine with a very small, strategic allocation, the team was sometimes insistent on pushing a much larger percentage toward these options. I believe the core advisory service is truly top-tier, but Fintoo needs to ensure their product recommendations prioritize the client's fiduciary needs over else.
